# On the detection of synthetic images generated by diffusion models
- **id:** corvi-icassp2023
- **Authors / venue / year:** Riccardo Corvi, Davide Cozzolino, Giada Zingarini, Giovanni Poggi, Koki Nagano, Luisa Verdoliva / ICASSP 2023 [venue unverified: the arXiv abstract page fetched shows no venue; ICASSP 2023 per project brief] / 2022-23
- **Links:** arXiv 2211.00680 · https://arxiv.org/abs/2211.00680 · https://github.com/grip-unina/DMimageDetection
- **Family:** low-level (noise-residual fingerprints + CNN without early downsampling)
- **Status:** read-full

## Summary (plain language)
First systematic study of whether GAN-era detectors work on diffusion images. Diffusion models (GLIDE, Latent/Stable Diffusion) leave periodic fingerprints like GANs, but ADM and DALL-E 2 leave very weak ones. Detectors trained on GANs fail on diffusion output, especially after realistic resize + JPEG; training on a diffusion model helps only for similar diffusion models. Its Latent-Diffusion-trained detector ("DMID") became a standard baseline.

## How it works
Artifact analysis (Sec. 3): noise residual R = X - f(X) with the DnCNN denoiser; average residuals of 1000 images; Fourier amplitude shows peaks (Fig. 2). Detectors compared: Spec (Zhang), PatchForensics, Wang2020 (ResNet-50 + blur/JPEG aug), Grag2021 (ResNet-50 without down-sampling in the first layer + intense augmentation). Best (Grag2021) is retrained on Latent Diffusion; outputs of ProGAN- and LDM-trained models are fused by averaging, optionally Platt-scaled.

## Training data
(a) ProGAN, 362K fake, 20 categories (Wang protocol); (b) Latent Diffusion, 200K fake images, 5 categories (the same repo ships a 200K-fake / 200K-real LDM training set built from COCO and LSUN). Test: 1000 synthetic per generator, 5000 real, from COCO / ImageNet / UCID; 12 generators (ProGAN, StyleGAN2, StyleGAN3, BigGAN, EG3D, Taming Transformer, DALL-E Mini, DALL-E 2, GLIDE, Latent Diffusion, Stable Diffusion, ADM).

## Reported results
Metrics Acc (threshold 0.5) / AUC %. 
- Trained on ProGAN, Table 1 averages over 12 generators: uncompressed PNG: Spec 70.5/75.2, PatchFor 51.9/83.2, Wang2020 59.5/78.6, Grag2021 75.8/92.8. Resized (crop, 200x200) + JPEG Q in [65,100]: Spec 52.7/52.7, PatchFor 50.4/69.2, Wang2020 55.8/75.0, Grag2021 61.5/90.8.
- Grag2021 (ProGAN) on Stable Diffusion: PNG 62.1/92.9 -> compressed 58.1/93.7; ADM: 51.2/57.4 -> 50.6/77.2; DALL-E 2: 51.9/94.9 -> 50.0/64.4 (Table 1).
- Table 2: Grag2021 trained on Latent Diffusion and tested on the resized/compressed set: LDM 97.1/99.9, Stable Diffusion 99.7/100, ADM 52.9/81.9, DALL-E 2 50.4/74.2, avg 66.9/89.2. Fusion with ProGAN model: avg 64.5/94.1; with Platt calibration (2 real + 2 fake per generator): avg 87.8/94.1.
- Calibration on fresh real photos: not done; the authors show fixed threshold gives chance accuracy despite high AUC, and calibration with just 4 images per generator lifts accuracy (Table 2).

## Known weaknesses / failure modes
- From the paper: AUC is decent but accuracy at fixed threshold is near random under compression/resizing; "we still cannot reliably detect images that present artifacts significantly different from those seen during training"; ADM and DALL-E 2 have weak fingerprints. Preliminary study ("only preliminary results").
- Later: B-Free (arXiv 2412.17671, Table 5) lists DMID bAcc: Midjourney 100, SDXL 99.7, DALL-E 2 50.1, DALL-E 3 50.0, Firefly 51.0, FLUX 63.7, SD 3.5 99.9, and on WildRF Facebook/Reddit/Twitter 87.8/74.3/79.1 (avg 75.6). SPAI (CVPR 2025, Table 1): DMID avg AUC 83.5 over 13 modern generators (DALL-E 3 41.3, Glide 73.1, DALL-E 2 54.3, GigaGAN 67.9). So the LDM-trained detector transfers to SD-family models but not to DALL-E/Firefly-like pipelines and loses accuracy on newer models.

## Relevance to this project
- Concrete evidence that fingerprint-style detectors lose accuracy after resize+JPEG and that the decision threshold, not the ranking, is what breaks; motivates calibration on fresh real photos.
- Shows generalization is family-specific (SD-like vs ADM/DALL-E 2); supplies a reproducible resize+JPEG test protocol (random crop, 200x200, JPEG Q65-100).
